chat.heading: Ask about tricking
chat.intro: The assistant only answers about tricking: tricks, technique and the history of the sport. It uses the tricks you already marked as learned to personalize its recommendations. It does not write code or answer unrelated topics.
chat.comboAsk: Do you want it with the tricks you already have or a free combo with catalog tricks?
chat.comboKnownIntro: Combo with the tricks you already have:
chat.inputPlaceholder: For example: how do you do a b-twist
chat.empty: There are no questions yet. Write the first one.
chat.refusal: I can only help with tricking: tricks, technique and the history of the sport. I do not write code or answer unrelated topics. Ask me about a trick.
chat.notConfigured: The AI assistant is not configured in this environment. You can still use the catalog and the combo generator.
chat.errorTitle: We could not get an answer
chat.errorDescription: There was a problem contacting the assistant. Please try again.
chat.rateLimited: You asked too many questions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
chat.dailyLimit: The daily limit of assistant requests was reached. Try again tomorrow.

prompt.contextIntro: Catalog context (use it only if relevant):
prompt.contextEmpty: - No results in the catalog for this question.
prompt.knownIntro: Tricks the user ALREADY has (do not explain them from scratch or recommend them as new):
prompt.suggestionsIntro: Catalog tricks you MAY recommend (real follow-ups to what the user knows). Do NOT recommend any trick that is not in this list or the catalog context:
prompt.catalogSampleIntro: Random catalog sample for a free combo (you may pick tricks from here). Real names only:

combos.heading: Combo generator
combos.intro: Build a combo using only the tricks you already marked as learned.
combos.noTricksTitle: There are no learned tricks yet
combos.noTricksDescription: Mark tricks as learned in the catalog so the generator can use them.
combos.copyFailed: We could not copy the combo
combos.emptyResultDescription: With the selected filters there are not enough tricks to build a combo. Adjust the filters or mark more tricks.
combos.errorTitle: We could not generate the combo
combos.errorDescription: There was a problem generating the combo. Please try again.
combos.rateLimited: You requested too many combos in a row. Wait a moment.
combos.dailyLimit: The daily limit of AI generations was reached.
combos.idleDescription: Adjust the filters and press Generate to build a combo.
combos.saved: Combo saved. Edit it in your combos.
combos.saveError: We could not save the combo.
combos.saveLimitReached: You reached the maximum of 5 saved combos. Edit or delete one to save another.
